label: alert-quiet-4096
validation_scope: 28 suites: ordinary O0/O3, ThinLTO O3, ASan O0/O1; explicit LTO checks; seven ordinary O3 application oracles; freshly built Rust references. No benchmark timings.
method: Exact timed ThinLTO Imre/Rust binaries; whole-process Callgrind and DHAT at 128 queries, DHAT again at 256. Original timed input bytes, only repeat argument changed. Independent complete stdout/checksum/filesystem oracle after every process. No wall-time samples or builds.
limits: Callgrind Ir counts guest instructions, not CPU cycles or wall-time speedup. Inclusive costs overlap. DHAT counts requested heap bytes/blocks, not RSS; gb/gbk share the global peak. Exit-live counts alone do not establish leaks. Two-count allocation slopes are descriptive, not a proof of linearity.
